item.text: IBAC’s Operation Turton investigated alleged unauthorised access to and disclosure of information at the former Metropolitan Fire Brigade.
item.support: Operation Turton investigated allegations of unauthorised access and disclosure of information

item.text: IBAC identified five incidents and found weaknesses in information security and workplace culture.
item.support: IBAC identified five separate incidents where MFB information was accessed or disclosed without authorisation

item.text: It concluded that information was accessed or disclosed without authority, often to advance union interests, and identified barriers to reporting and addressing improper conduct.
item.support: IBAC also found barriers for reporting improper conduct and for management to address issues

item.text: IBAC made four recommendations to Fire Rescue Victoria on consultation, information security, sharing information with unions and internal complaints.
item.support: IBAC is making four recommendations to FRV to strengthen its information security infrastructure

item.quote: Operation Turton found deficiencies in MFB’s culture and vulnerabilities in its information and communication technology (ICT) systems, contributing to significant corruption risks.
IBAC also found barriers for reporting improper conduct and for management to address issues.
